tasks.title: merge_sorted
tasks.objective:
Write only Python: def merge_sorted(a, b):
    i = j = 0
    out = []
    while i < len(a) and j < len(b):
        if a[i] <= b[j]:
            out.append(a[i]); i += 1
        else:
            out.append(b[j]); j += 1
    out.extend(a[i:]); out.extend(b[j:])
    return out
print(merge_sorted([1,3,5],[2,4,6]))
